title: Development of a SayCan-based Task Planning System Capable of Handling Abstract Nouns

publication: Proceedings of the 2024 International Conference on Artificial Life and Robotics (ICAROB2024)
publication_short: ICAROB2024
abstract: The task planning system is required to accomplish various requests from a human in real -world
  environments. SayCan, one of the task planning systems, has high accuracy . However, its accuracy decreases
  for requests that include abstract nouns of the ambiguous word/phrase. We propose a novel task planning
  system based on SayCan that introduces a function for checking concrete names of abstract nouns and
  a rule -based skill extraction , enhancing accuracy . The proposed system facilitates the interpretation
  of requests and enables appropriate task planning. The effectiveness of the proposed system was demonstrated
  at RoboCup@Home, where it achieved high performance .
